notes: Adds visibility into whether the cPanel IP Blocker integration is actually working: the Blocked IPs page (Free Service Gateway) now has a 'cPanel' column showing, per IP, whether it was successfully registered with cPanel's IP Blocker - hover it for the exact reason if it failed (wrong token, wrong host, etc). Same info is also queryable directly from the database (gateway_blocked_ips.cpanel_synced_at / cpanel_sync_error). Requires 'Update database' (adds two nullable columns to gateway_blocked_ips).
